WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)') AS rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, '(no status)')
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
), qualifying_statuses AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, sa.avg_modindex - oa.avg_modindex AS above_average
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  above_average,
  avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying_statuses;
